(28 matches) | highest attendance = 20,000 for Zamalek{{Cite web|url=https://www.kingfut.com/2019/10/21/feature-egypt-fans/|title = FEATURE: Disappointing Attendance in Egypt After AFCON|date = 21 October 2019}} | lowest attendance = | average attendance = | prevseason = [[2013–14 Egyptian Premier League|2013–14]] | nextseason = [[2015–16 Egyptian Premier League|2015–16]] }} The '''2014–15 Egyptian Premier League''' was the 56th season of the [[Egyptian Premier League]], the top Egyptian professional league for association football clubs, since its establishment in 1948. The season started on 15 September 2014 and concluded on 3 August 2015. ==Teams== A total of 20 teams contested the league, including 17 sides from the 2013–14 season and 3 promoted from the [[2013–14 Egyptian Second Division]]. This includes the promotion play-off winners ([[Ala'ab Damanhour]], [[Alassiouty Sport|Al Assiouty Sport]] and [[Al Nasr FC (Cairo)|Al Nasr]]).{{cite news|title=نادي ألعاب دمنهور يعود للدوري الممتاز بعد 22 عام|url=http://www.kooora.com/?n=339340|access-date=25 June 2014|work=kooora.com|language=ar}}{{cite news|title=الأسيوطي والنصر يصعدان للدوري الممتاز لأول مرة في تاريخهما|url=http://www.kooora.com/?n=339515|access-date=25 June 2014|work=kooora.com|language=ar}} [[Alassiouty Sport|Al Assiouty Sport]] and [[Al Nasr FC (Cairo)|Al Nasr]] made their [[Egyptian Premier League|Premier League]] debut.
